import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode

class Hou_Mcp_Predictive_Execution(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_predictive_execution"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("operations_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("context_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("include_resource_pred", "bool", widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_input("queue_depth", "int", widget_type="int", default=0)
        self.add_output("predicted_risk", "string")
        self.add_output("failure_probability", "float")
        self.add_output("risk_factors", "any")
        self.add_output("recommendations", "any")
        self.add_output("resource_pressure", "any")
        self.add_output("scheduler_status", "any")
        self.add_output("prediction_json", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        try:
            from src.runtime.predictive_execution import get_predictive_engine
            engine = get_predictive_engine()

            ops_raw = inputs.get("operations_json") or "[]"
            ctx_raw = inputs.get("context_json") or "{}"
            try:
                operations = json.loads(ops_raw) if isinstance(ops_raw, str) else ops_raw
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                operations = []
            try:
                context = json.loads(ctx_raw) if isinstance(ctx_raw, str) else ctx_raw
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                context = {}

            prediction = engine.predict(operations, context)
            resource_pressure = {}
            if inputs.get("include_resource_pred", True):
                resource_pressure = engine.predict_resource_pressure(operations)

            queue_depth = int(inputs.get("queue_depth") or 0)
            scheduler_status = engine.predict_scheduler_congestion(queue_depth)

            full = {**prediction, "resource_pressure": resource_pressure, "scheduler_status": scheduler_status}
            return {
                "predicted_risk":      prediction["predicted_risk"],
                "failure_probability": prediction["failure_probability"],
                "risk_factors":        prediction["risk_factors"],
                "recommendations":     prediction["recommendations"],
                "resource_pressure":   resource_pressure,
                "scheduler_status":    scheduler_status,
                "prediction_json":     json.dumps(full),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"Predictive execution error: {e}")
            return {"predicted_risk": "unknown", "failure_probability": 0.0, "risk_factors": [], "recommendations": [], "resource_pressure": {}, "scheduler_status": {}, "prediction_json": "{}", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Predictive_Execution
